<div class="card-body">
'''Fall Back!''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">撤退せよ！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手の合計戦闘力が自分の側の２倍を越えている屋外の位置で相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使用する。１フォース消費して、戦闘をキャンセルし、そこにいる自分のキャラクターを全員、敵が人員を持っていない隣接位置に移動させる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Fall-Back-PSA-157878137.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「Kワンゼロへ、全兵員は任務を放棄せよ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Fall back!

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after the opponent declares a battle at an exterior location where the opponent's total power is more than double yours. Use 1 Force to cancel the battle and move all of your characters there to an adjacent location where the opponent has no presence.

'''Lore:'''
"To K-10, all troops abandon the mission."
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Fall Back!]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
